extraction_notes: M7 is the M1-M7 family member with VRRM = 1000 V, VRMS = 700 V, VDC = 1000 V, IF(AV) = 1.0 A, and IFSM = 30.0 A in the p. 1 maximum ratings table.
The separate high-temperature reverse-current row is IR2 = 200 uA at VR = VDC and Ta = 125 degC; the fitted reverse-current input uses the Ta = 25 degC IR1 maximum of 2.0 uA.
No reverse-recovery-time value or test circuit is published, so reverse recovery is not represented in reverse_recovery.
VRRM and VDC are blocking ratings, not measured breakdown voltage/current data; breakdown_voltage and breakdown_current remain null.
Curve points were digitized from the vector plots on p. 2. Reverse-current plot values shown in uA were converted to A; no points were interpolated beyond the plotted curves.
